summary: Implemented phases 1-4 of the 11-phase gate-framework refactor, each closed cleanly and committed before the next opened. Phases 1-2 fixed and generalized verify-deploy.sh's unanchored finding-extraction defect (14 call sites) with an SGR-stripping anchored helper, proven via unit-level and live-corpus equivalence. Phase 3 built scripts/measure-gate-costs.sh (idle-load-guarded, averaged, two cost classes documented) and captured a clean, fully-idle 23-gate cost table after discarding a severely contaminated first attempt (a live sibling-session contention spike to load 50+). Phase 4 introduced the declarative gate registry (gate-registry.data + gate-registry-lib.sh) and migrated gates 1-8, confirmed byte-identical stdout/stderr/exit-code before vs after. Paused at this clean phase boundary rather than opening Phase 5 (migrate gates 9-23, full-battery verification tier) given the substantial real-world time already spent on idle-load waits and full-battery measurements during this dispatch.
